suppliedTrace.limitation: Every function name occurs at most once; only three model-cache log lines repeat. This establishes recorded presence/order, not frame cadence or call counts. Absence of wrapper8022026C is not absence of its native call: inspected08002E34 invokes it.

syncConsequence: After native release the cursor still equals a formerly tracked flash and alpha reads255. Pointer-equality-only capture falsely reports a fully opaque live flash. Track the release boundary and validate active kind1 plus owning task-list membership; do not rewrite the native global cursor to hide the stale alias.
limitations: No timing duration is inferred from the function-presence trace.
Only exact native lifecycle facts are public; mod protocol and regression provenance remain maintenance evidence.
No copied ROM or generated native function bodies are included.
